div.p: The patient presented on Oct 21, 2025 with a persistent cough beginning on Oct 10, 2025. Paroxysms of coughing began on Oct 18, 2025. No whooping respiration or post-tussive vomiting was reported. The patient denied fever or recent sick contacts but disclosed travel to [location] two weeks prior to symptom onset. Dr. Royce Hemlock evaluated the patient at Grand Republic Medical Facility Clinic, ordered laboratory testing, and initiated treatment with Azithromycin. Pertussis was confirmed by laboratory results.
